value.answer: Honestly, I'd call it overrated. It's well made and third-party tested, and most people say it tastes decent. But several of the doses come in under effective ranges, a dietitian says the science is much weaker than the marketing makes it sound, and I found no independent clinical evidence for the benefits. At around $89 a month on subscription, I'd skip it unless the convenience alone is worth that to you.
